title: O Soul-bride, Without Your Husband Lord, What
summary: Gratitude is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: The life of the discarded bride is cursed. She is deceived by the love of duality; o soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
